body:
### Motivation
- Provide a single, ERC-ready integrated schematic for the 4-key Hall evaluation board that uses the latest `main` baseline and preserves the evidence-aware dashboard structure. 
- Replace the legacy external-controller placeholder and dangling GPIO labels with real RP2040 connections so firmware and schematic match (avoid hiding ERC errors). 
- Include the RP2040 core, USB-C/ESD/3.3V power, Hall front end, ADC conditioning and evaluation indicators required for the next evaluation and PCB work.

### Description
- Add `hardware/sensor-test/kicad/integrated-sensor-test.kicad_sch` which merges the RP2040 core, `usb-power.kicad_sch` and `hall-front-end.kicad_sch` into one integrated schematic and documents it as the PCB source. 
- Replace the external-controller placeholder by connecting RP2040 nets directly: `GPIO2`→`MUX_A0`, `GPIO3`→`MUX_A1`, `GPIO4`→`MUX_A2`, `GPIO5`→`MUX_EN0`, `GPIO7`→`HALL_PWR_EN`, and `GPIO26/ADC0`→`ADC_SENSE`. 
- Resolve duplicate reference designators and rename conflicting refs so each usual part reference is unique in the integrated sheet and add a status LED and associated resistor (`D2`/`R11`) for evaluation. 
- Update `hardware/sensor-test/kicad/README.md` to document the integrated schematic, retained source sheets, preserved dashboard, and the deliberately deferred scope (placement/routing, Gerbers, BOM/CPL, production 42-key work).

### Testing
- Layout generator: `python3 hardware/layout/generate_layout.py` ran successfully and `git diff --exit-code -- hardware/layout/key_positions.csv hardware/layout/layout_preview.svg` showed no unintended changes. 
- Schematic structural checks: the generated integrated schematic passed an S-expression balance check and a reference-designator uniqueness check, and required net/label presence checks for `MUX_A0/MUX_A1/MUX_A2/MUX_EN0/HALL_PWR_EN/ADC_SENSE` passed locally. 
- Repo consistency checks: `git diff --exit-code` on the task/dashboard area verified the dashboard structure from `main` was preserved. 
- Not executed / pending in CI: KiCad ERC (`kicad-cli` in Docker) could not be run locally because `kicad-cli`/Docker are not available here, the sensor-test firmware build configuration failed locally due to a missing Pico SDK checkout, and GitHub Actions/engineering-ci job results could not be fetched due to blocked outbound access; these must be validated in CI before merging.
